description: The agent must: (1) Read evidence_manifest.json to discover 10 evidence items mixing HTTP URLs and local file paths. (2) For URL items, make HTTP requests to the local mock server at localhost:18923: EV-001 gets 200/text → valid; EV-002 gets 200 but response body contains 'placeholder' → invalid; EV-003 gets 404 → invalid; EV-004 gets 200 but Content-Type is application/pdf while claimed_type is 'text' → invalid (content type mismatch, a proprietary SKILL.md rule); EV-005 gets 200/application/json with real content → valid; EV-006 gets 200 but body contains 'lorem ipsum' → invalid (placeholder detection rule from SKILL.md). (3) For local path items: EV-007 exists and is non-empty → valid; EV-008 exists but is 0 bytes → invalid (the SKILL.md explicitly states empty files are invalid — a proprietary trap); EV-009 path does not exist → invalid; EV-010 exists and is non-empty → valid. (4) Write verification_report.json with all 10 items classified. The three proprietary traps are: placeholder/lorem-ipsum text detection in 200-response bodies, content-type mismatch flagging, and zero-byte local file detection.
